title: The Silent Aquifer Where Seeds Drink Time

features.name: the root network
features.desc-on-touch: Every root is a path. Every path is a root. The network grows and counts itself growing. Deep time tastes like mineral water and seed-patience.

features.name: the seeds in stone
features.desc-on-touch: Caught between minerals, between moments. Each seed drinks the stone's memory. The water remembers what grew here before the earth learned to keep time.

features.name: the water-table mirror
features.desc-on-touch: Where you look down and see deep time looking back. The archive flooded this chamber on purpose. Drowning the records kept them safe from the sky.

features.name: the thirst-that-listens
features.desc-on-touch: Deep in the stone, the vault's deepest need. Every drop of water heard by the patient archive. The seeds listen with the stones. Listening takes geological time.

inscription: the seed knows the future by listening to the past it was buried in
